title: “Go eat a bat, Chang!”: On the Emergence of Sinophobic Behavior on Web Communities in the Face of COVID-19
reasoning: The paper is a computational social science study analyzing the emergence and evolution of Sinophobic hate speech and racist rhetoric on Twitter and 4chan during the COVID-19 pandemic. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or formal ethical/moral systems; rather, it performs a data-driven analysis of online human behavior.
